messages.author: 9d042f463d42ef40
messages.subject: Shiny Server process killed Automatically.
parts:
Hi Guys,

We installed Shiny server  v0.4.0 in centos 5.9 machine. It's working good as expected. But the only problem is node process terminated automatically.

please check console output

[root@dvdhan18 ~]# shiny-server &
[1] 14566
[root@dvdhan18 ~]# [2013-09-03 09:02:06.153] [INFO] shiny-server - Shiny Server v0.4.0 (Node.js v0.10.15)
[2013-09-03 09:02:06.156] [INFO] shiny-server - Using config file "/etc/shiny-server/shiny-server.conf"
[2013-09-03 09:02:06.271] [WARN] shiny-server - Running as root unnecessarily is a security risk! You could be running more securely as non-root.
[2013-09-03 09:02:06.274] [INFO] shiny-server - Starting listener on 0.0.0.0:3838
[2013-09-03 09:02:06.305] [INFO] shiny-server - Socket dir: /var/shiny-server/sockets

[root@dvdhan 18 ~]# ps -aux |grep shiny-server
Warning: bad syntax, perhaps a bogus '-'? See /usr/share/doc/procps-3.2.7/FAQ
root     14566  0.3  0.0 646664 28816 pts/0    Sl   09:02   0:00 node /usr/local/bin/shiny-server

Actually the shiny-server internally calling node. I don't see any log from node.

I tired http://blog.nodejitsu.com/keep-a-nodejs-server-up-with-forever

forever
startprocess as background
nonub

not helping me.

Please guide me. guys

-Dhanasekaran.

messages.author: bbc57ffa8a14ad13
messages.subject: Re: Shiny Server process killed Automatically.
parts:
Thanks, Dhanasekaran.

We're actually aware of a couple of outstanding issues with process killing. We've got (at least) one bug open for this: https://github.com/rstudio/shiny-server/issues/37 . We'll be working to get this sorted out ASAP.

Jeff
